stem: Voltmarkt's head of customer success asks about Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices: "Of the businesses that first paid in January 2026, what share was still paying in June?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: 100 × January starters active in June / January starters
100 × businesses lost in June / businesses active on 1 June
100 × the cohort's capped MRR in June / its MRR in January
100 × the cohort's MRR in June / its MRR in January
